flags.why: Xót commonly expresses distress over losing or wasting something valuable, especially money.
flags.fix: to feel pained at losing or wasting something; example: Tôi xót tiền quá. = It pains me to waste that money.

flags.why: Gở means ominous or inauspicious, not a demon or monster ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-g%E1%BB%9F)).
Vật tư refers to materials and supplies for work or production, not personal belongings.
Cấp dưỡng means providing someone's livelihood, not nourishing the body through food ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-c%E1%BA%A5p%20d%C6%B0%E1%BB%A1ng)).
The standalone word phích is most commonly encountered meaning a thermos flask, while the electrical sense usually appears as phích điện or phích cắm.
Riêng lẻ means separate or individual, not private in the sense of personal or confidential.
